newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan Nov domestic output down 4.1% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Nissan Nov domestic output down 4.1% yr/yr.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Thursday its domestic vehicle production, exports, domestic sales and overseas ouptut in November were as follows:

Nissan's domestic vehicle production fell in November for the fourth straight month year-on-year, as the "new model effect" -- when the launch of new models generates buying interest -- wore off for its sedan models.
Domestic vehicle sales rose for the first time in two months, reflecting good demand for recreational vehicles and cheaper versions of the March sub-compact car.
Its overseas production rose for the fifth successive month, mainly due to higher output at its Mexican unit and higher output of the Micra and Primera at its British unit.
Nissan's exports rose for the third straight month, helped by higher U.S. demand for its Pathfinder, its Infiniti Q45 and other new models.
